turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 5 (playbook §4: the automation part in this hospital’s own hold-ups).

transcript.label: Sample conversation · turn 5 · the automatic paperwork

text: Here is what the software does at your hospital, from the 7 PM round to the patient going home. Why each piece matters:
bullets: It starts at the evening round, because your doctors already decide then. Nothing new is asked of them.
It keeps the bill up to date all day, so billing stops waiting for the nurses to count supplies.
It sends the first bill to insurance overnight, so the morning is not spent waiting for approval.
chat.invite: Next is the changes on the wards: what each team does differently.
chat.note: The papers are ready before the doctor signs.

points.label: What your IT team must do first

prompts: Show me the changes on the wards

blocks.condition: What must happen first: your IT team lets Tojo read your records. Without that link, none of these papers fill in.

sheets.title: Discharge summary
sheets.text: Drafted from notes, tests and medicines already in your files. The doctor checks and signs on the morning round.

hand.does: Checks the draft and signs it on a phone.

sheets.title: The running bill
sheets.text: Each charge goes on the bill as it happens, so it is ready when the doctor signs.
sheets.entry: How long does your final bill take?

hand.does: Checks the bill before it goes out.

sheets.title: Insurance request
sheets.text: A first bill goes to the insurer the evening before, so approval is not waited for in the morning.
sheets.entry: Which insurers do most of your patients use?

sheets.title: Medicines to take home
sheets.text: The list goes to the pharmacy on the evening round, so the medicines are packed by morning.
sheets.entry: When does the pharmacy pack medicines now?

sheets.title: Supplies going back
sheets.text: What was given, used and left over is worked out from the records. Nurses check it, instead of counting first.
sheets.entry: Who counts the used supplies today?

blocks.label: Hours each patient waits today
blocks.sub: Your own figure. This part is aimed at those hours. How many it removes here, a short trial will show.
